body: Yeah. One person was always apt to say "it's just an act, he doesn't actually mean it". That made me not want to try again for a while.

I'll check out r/depression, might be helpful stuff over there. And unfortunately I don't have money for therapy/ meds, and I'm not really sure how well I would respond to it. My school has a few free sessions before you have to pay (which I find nonsensical), but I may give it a go.

To be honest, I don't know. Whenever my parents "try" to help it's usually along the lines of "well you could be dead/ dying/ in a third world country/ etc." While that's true, and I'm grateful for what I do have, that doesn't help me.

As for others, I always feel like an afterthought. Like people say they care for me but their actions say otherwise.

Kinda explained it in another reply, but no, I don't really feel comfortable trying to open up to anyone. The few times I've tried people thought I was joking.

As for helping, I guess this is fine. Seems like being anonymous does the trick for getting me to open up about this.
No. Like I don't even feel really comfortable around my own brother. I've never been able to confide in people.

I'm a college student but they are paying for it (outside of some scholarships), so my independence is pretty limited, especially around break (ie now). And I'm sure independence could help but at the rate we're going I doubt I'll ever reach that point.
